Suitable for kitchen, infant room, basement, bedroom, bathroom, living room, laundry room, studio and other windows, providing you with a good sleeping environment. Of course, they are not just tier curtains for windows, they can also be used on closet, shelf or any places you want to put on for privacy protection. Curtains block out up to 70% of light. Heavy duty material helps to block most unwanted sunlight and reduce street noise.
